name: Sho Nishigaki
bio: Nishigaki Sho is a Japanese actor who was born on May 26, 1999, in Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. He attended Keio University and made his acting debut in 2021, when he starred in the drama series titles “I'm Crazy About You,” “Dragon Zakura 2,” and “Three Star Bar in Nishi Ogikubo” (all 2021).
